requirements.statement: An API Consumer can send a GET request to /hello and receive a JSON response confirming the service is up and reachable

criteria.must: A GET request to /hello returns HTTP status 200

requirements.statement: The /hello response body is always exactly {"message":"Hello, World!"}

criteria.must: The response body is exactly {"message":"Hello, World!"}
Repeated GET requests to /hello return the same fixed body every time
